messages.content: Please price the transportation as a complete trip cost, including resort parking, rather than comparing only the rental rate. Then line up the Tuesday massages and a rainforest outing so we still have several days with nothing scheduled.

For February 21-28, the lowest all-in weekly rental I found is $642, including taxes and airport fees. The Hyatt charges $35 per night for self-parking, adding $245, and estimated tolls are $18-$25. That puts the week at about $905-$912 before fuel. A private round-trip SJU transfer is $356 for two, including taxes and gratuity. Adding a one-day midsize rental delivered to the resort is $138, with one night of parking at $35 and about $8 in tolls, for roughly $537 before fuel. The transfer-plus-one-day-rental plan saves about $370.
Does the private transfer still work with our flight times, and is the price actually private rather than a shared shuttle?

Yes. It is a private SUV for the two of you. Arrival pickup is scheduled for 1:45 p.m. at SJU on Saturday, February 21, with flight tracking and 60 minutes of complimentary wait time after landing. The return pickup would be 10:45 a.m. from the Hyatt on Saturday, February 28 for the 2:40 p.m. flight. The $356 total covers both directions, taxes, airport charges, and gratuity; extra waiting beyond the included period is $20 per 30 minutes.
Good. What are the rainforest choices that do not interfere with the Tuesday 2:00 p.m. massages?

Two guided options remain available. A half-day El Yunque walk on Thursday, February 26 picks up at the Hyatt at 7:15 a.m. and returns around 1:30 p.m. It costs $398 for two, including transportation, entry arrangements, guide, water, taxes, and gratuity. The remaining full-day option on Wednesday runs 8:00 a.m.-4:30 p.m., costs $332 for two, and requires meeting at a Rio Grande shopping center about 20 minutes from the resort. The half-day tour has four places left; the full-day tour has broader availability.
The Thursday half-day sounds cleaner. Confirm that the return estimate leaves no appointment or check-in obligation later that day.

Correct. The spa appointments are Tuesday, February 24 at 2:00 p.m., while the excursion is Thursday, February 26. The Thursday tour ends with resort drop-off, normally between 1:15 and 1:30 p.m., and there is no scheduled activity afterward. The operator notes that weather and traffic can shift the return by up to an hour.
And where would the one-day rental fit? I do not want it placed on Monday, Tuesday, or Friday.

Wednesday, February 25 is available. Enterprise can deliver a midsize car to the Hyatt at 9:00 a.m. and collect it Thursday at 8:00 a.m. The $138 total includes taxes, delivery, and the additional driver for your spouse; resort parking adds $35. That leaves Sunday, Monday, and Friday completely open, keeps Tuesday limited to the massages, and uses Wednesday for any independent driving you decide to do.
Will Thursday collection conflict with the 7:15 rainforest pickup?

It would, because the rental desk requires an in-person return inspection. A better interval is Wednesday from 8:30 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. Same-day delivery and collection increases the rental total to $151, but eliminates overnight parking. With about $8 in tolls, the complete transfer-and-rental plan becomes approximately $515 before fuel, still about $390 less than keeping a car all week.
That is better. Are the transfer, Wednesday car, and Thursday tour refundable, and which one has limited availability?

The private transfer can be canceled without charge through 1:45 p.m. AST on February 19; later cancellation is charged in full. The Wednesday rental can be canceled through 8:30 a.m. AST on February 24 with no penalty, and no prepayment is required. The Thursday rainforest tour is fully refundable through 7:15 a.m. AST on February 23; after that it is nonrefundable. The tour is the time-sensitive item because only four spaces remain. The transfer operator has multiple vehicles, and the rental is not currently showing limited inventory.

Reserve the Thursday half-day tour for both of us at $398, and book the private round-trip transfer at $356. Also reserve the Wednesday 8:30 a.m.-7:00 p.m. rental at $151. Do not add insurance or prepaid fuel. Leave the rest of the week alone.

The Thursday, February 26 half-day El Yunque tour is confirmed for two at $398, with Hyatt pickup at 7:15 a.m. and expected return around 1:30 p.m. The full amount was charged; cancellation is penalty-free through 7:15 a.m. AST on February 23. The private SJU transfers are confirmed at $356 total, with arrival pickup February 21 at 1:45 p.m. and resort pickup February 28 at 10:45 a.m.; that amount was also charged. The Enterprise midsize rental is reserved for resort delivery Wednesday, February 25 at 8:30 a.m. and collection at 7:00 p.m. for $151, payable at pickup. No insurance or prepaid fuel was added. Tuesday retains only the two 2:00 p.m. massages, Wednesday has the car, Thursday has the tour, and Sunday, Monday, and Friday remain unscheduled.
